dict.string: PepBox needs to communicate with this app to export items when you drag them to the shelf or basket, and to find your Google Meet tab for Meeting controls.
Voice Transcribe needs access to your microphone to record audio for transcription.
Notchface needs access to your camera to show your live notch preview.
PepBox uses Bluetooth to detect AirPods connections and show battery status.
PepBox needs Reminders access to sync reminder items into your Reminders tasks.
PepBox needs full Reminders access to keep Reminders tasks synced with Apple Reminders changes.
PepBox needs Calendar access to show upcoming events in your task overview.
PepBox needs full Calendar access to keep upcoming events synced in your task overview.
